summary: Use runtime fallback when Promise chaining can observe a subclass constructor or custom Symbol.species.

requirements.receiver: Promise subclass or unknown promise object

target.notes: Runtime must implement SpeciesConstructor and custom constructor capability semantics before creating the derived promise.

semantics.symbol_species_getter: observable and may run user code or throw

caveats: Hard-wiring JsPromise changes instanceof/constructor-observable behavior for subclasses.

tests.name: subclass chaining returns subclass
tests.input: class P extends Promise{};const p=P.resolve(1);console.log(p.then(x=>x) instanceof P);

tests.name: species can select base Promise
tests.input: class P extends Promise{static get [Symbol.species](){return Promise}};const q=P.resolve(1).then(x=>x);console.log(q instanceof P);
